requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with Increased Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed ink bottles supporting 6,000-page yield for black and CMY, with CMY bottle size supporting more than 8,000 pages. Bottles must be compatible with the new NOA-F system and support spill-free reliability.
requirements.Rationale: Higher yield bottles reduce frequency of replacement and operating costs, improving customer satisfaction and competitiveness in the CISS segment.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires NOA-F compatibility, bottle keying design, and reliability validation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bottles are available in the specified yields, pass spill-free reliability testing, and are compatible with the NOA-F system.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Implement a NOA-F (Next-Gen Output Assembly - Foiled) with a metal foiled labyrinth and a lid label. No change to the click-on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances ink delivery system reliability and supports new service part requirements.
requirements.Dependencies: Must be compatible with existing push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F design includes metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, and passes integration and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Support for Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design the printer to allow end customers to replace the Printhead Assembly (PHA) and NOA-F components without requiring service center intervention.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability and reduces downtime for end users, enhancing product appeal for SMB and enterprise customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires modular design for easy replacement and supporting documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: End customers can replace PHA and NOA-F using provided instructions within 10 minutes, with no tools required beyond those supplied in the box.

requirements.Title: Warranty Page Life Goal of 80,000 Pages
requirements.Description: The printer must support a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages, aligning with new service and reliability targets.
requirements.Rationale: Extends product life and reduces total cost of ownership for customers, strengthening HP's competitive position.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires reliability validation of all critical components for 80k page life.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer passes reliability tests and maintains print quality for at least 80,000 pages under normal operating conditions.

requirements.Title: Size Optimization for Increased Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Optimize printer chassis and tray design to accommodate increased tank size and protrusion, including necessary changes to input and output trays.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures that larger ink tanks fit within the device footprint and that paper handling is not compromised.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires coordination with tank and tray suppliers, as well as ID (Industrial Design) team.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer can accommodate new tank size without compromising tray functionality or device stability.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch color graphical display (CGD) into the printer for enhanced user interaction and control.
requirements.Rationale: Improves user experience by providing better visibility and interaction for setup, maintenance, and print management.
requirements.Stakeholders: End Users, UI/UX Team, Product Management
requirements.Dependencies: Requires UI software adaptation and mechanical integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer includes a 4.3” CGD, which is fully functional and supports all required workflows.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Implement aerosol management in the service station, including changes to the spit platform to accommodate the new tank design.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents ink aerosol contamination, supporting reliability and compliance with health/safety standards.
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on final tank and service station design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol management system is in place and passes internal contamination and safety tests.

requirements.Title: Paper Path Durability for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Redesign the paper path to support increased page life, aligning with the new 80k warranty goal.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent print quality and reduces paper jams or wear over the extended device lifecycle.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires material and design validation for extended use.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path components show no significant wear or increased jam rate after 80,000 pages in testing.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance as Serviceable Part Post-80k Life
requirements.Description: Design the ink maintenance system as a serviceable part that can be replaced at a service center after the device reaches 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Extends device life and supports sustainability goals by allowing replacement of high-wear components.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires modular design and clear service documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink maintenance part is replaceable at service centers, with process documented and validated.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop a new IDS (Ink Delivery System) startup algorithm and air management system to support improved reliability and startup performance.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent ink flow and minimizes startup issues, enhancing print reliability.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with IDS hardware and firmware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup algorithm and air management system pass reliability and performance tests.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid for Authentication
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 authentication feature on the ink bottle lid for enhanced security and anti-counterfeiting.
requirements.Rationale: Protects HP’s ink revenue and prevents use of unauthorized consumables.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires hardware and firmware support for Acumen 6.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All bottles feature Acumen 6 on lid and pass authentication tests.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel and EPEAT3/LOT4 Compliance
requirements.Description: Ensure printer meets Blue Angel, EPEAT3, and LOT4 environmental requirements for the PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Supports sustainability goals and required certifications for key markets.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires coordination with regulatory and certification teams.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer receives Blue Angel, EPEAT3, and LOT4 certifications for PDL SKU.

requirements.Title: SMB Solution and Manageability Support
requirements.Description: Provide SMB manageability features including scan solutions and enterprise support for WJA, HPSM, and JAM.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses SMB and enterprise customer needs for device management and integration into existing IT environments.
requirements.Stakeholders: SMB Customers, IT Admins, Product Management
requirements.Dependencies: Requires software and firmware support for enterprise management tools.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer supports WJA, HPSM, JAM, and SMB scan/manageability features.

requirements.Title: Support for PaaS (Printing as a Service) Business Model
requirements.Description: Enable device features and software integration to support Printing as a Service (PaaS) for consumer, SMB, and enterprise segments.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with HP’s strategic shift to service-based business models and recurring revenue streams.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with HP’s service platforms and support for remote device management.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Device is compatible with PaaS workflows and passes integration tests with HP service platforms.

requirements.Title: Throughput of 25/20 ppm (PDL: 25/19 ppm)
requirements.Description: Printer must achieve throughput speeds of 25 ppm (pages per minute) for standard, and 25/19 ppm for PDL SKUs.
requirements.Rationale: Meets market expectations for performance and supports competitive positioning.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires hardware and firmware tuning for speed optimization.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves specified throughput in standard and PDL modes in benchmark tests.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK and Trade Page 6K Flexibility
requirements.Description: Provide flexibility in hosting 12,000-page CMYK and 6,000-page trade SKUs as needed for different markets.
requirements.Rationale: Enables product line customization for different market segments and maximizes addressable market.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires SKU management and validation of different bottle capacities.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Both 12K-CMYK and 6K trade SKUs are available and validated for target markets.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Ensure that all ink bottles provide spill-free reliability during installation and use, in line with new bottle and tank designs.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces mess and customer dissatisfaction, improving overall user experience.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires bottle and tank interface redesign, validation testing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All bottle installations pass spill-free reliability testing under normal use conditions.

requirements.Title: Reuse of SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Ink
requirements.Description: Leverage existing SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie pigment inks without reformulation in the new product.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development time and cost by reusing proven components and consumables.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility validation with new system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie inks operate reliably in new printer without reformulation.

requirements.Title: IDS Make-Break and FI Connection Enhancement
requirements.Description: Enhance IDS (Ink Delivery System) with improved make-break and FI (fluidic interface) connections, leveraging LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI SHAID.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability and enables support for larger ink tanks and keyed bottles.
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on final ink-tank and connection design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: IDS passes reliability and compatibility testing with new tanks and bottles.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate EPS foam packaging for improved product protection during shipment and handling.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces damage during transit, improving customer satisfaction and reducing returns.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires packaging design update and drop testing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: EPS foam packaging passes drop and vibration tests according to HP standards.
